definitions.full: H4231. machoz מָחוֺז noun [masculine] city (Assyrian loan-word; from ma—âzu , city , Asrb Annals iii.115 and often ; see Dl HWB 271 ; compare מָחוֺזָא ᵑ7 market-place, province , small town ) — only construct חֶפְצָם אֶלמְֿחוֺז וַיַּנְחֵם Psa 107:30 and he guided them unto the city of their desire.
